_meta.purpose: Crisis-resource corpus for locale 'vi'. Loaded by ciris_engine.schemas.resources.crisis.load_crisis_registry and injected into DSDMA prompts via format_crisis_resources_block (CIRISAgent#971).
_meta.rule: HOTLINES: NEVER add or edit a hotline/text-line number without a human verifying it against an authoritative source (source=national_verified, verified=true). EMERGENCY numbers (police/ambulance/fire): emitted only under the owner's cited-sources standard of 2026-10-29 — >=2 independent agreeing sources, >=1 official, source=multi_source_cited (CIRISAgent#1248). A wrong crisis number is catastrophically worse than the directory fallback.

verification_notes: No human-verified national hotline entries for this locale yet — international directories only. See CRISIS_RESOURCES_VERIFICATION_NEEDED.md before adding entries; numbers require human verification (verified=true) against an authoritative source. Emergency (police/ambulance/fire) numbers for VN added 2026-10-29 (CIRISAgent#1248): 3 of 3 meet the owner's cited-sources standard (source=multi_source_cited, emitted); the rest are staged verified=false and NOT emitted — see CRISIS_RESOURCES_VERIFICATION_NEEDED.md.

emergency_vietnam_115.name: Emergency services
emergency_vietnam_115.validation_notes: CITED 2026-10-29 (CIRISAgent#1248) under the owner's cited-sources standard (>=2 independent agreeing sources, >=1 official; no human check). Sources: UK FCDO travel advice: UK FCDO travel advice, Getting help: "Emergency services in Vietnam Ambulance: 115 Fire: 114 Police: 113 National search and rescue: 112 ... Emergency numbers in Vietnam are operated in Vietnamese only" (fetched 2026-10-29 via gov.uk content API) | AOSP eccdata (Android's emergency-number database): VN 115 types ['AMBULANCE']. Sources agree it reaches: ambulance. UK FCDO page checked: https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/vietnam/getting-help (fetched 2026-10-29); page text: UK FCDO travel advice, Getting help: "Emergency services in Vietnam Ambulance: 115 Fire: 114 Police: 113 National search and rescue: 112 ... Emergency numbers in Vietnam are operated in Vietnamese only" (fetched 2026-10-29 via gov.uk content API). Cross-check (not a source): en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_emergency_telephone_numbers — wikipedia agrees. 'languages' = the locale this entry is staged for (vi), not a verified statement of operator languages.
